bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/userbot-room-public-cb3e13c"
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = cb3e13c2156f5f8b04645adb121057e88d1c2b4a || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
old_inode=$(stat -c %i "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")
old_mode=$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")
test "$old_mode" = 600 || exit 72
for f in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py; do
 git -C "$w" show fb5aaa24e85f304261dd927e02bbcccc66bc4dfa:"$f" | cmp -s - "$r/$f" || exit 73
done
test ! -e "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" || exit 74
backup=$(mktemp -d "$r/.worktrees/room-public-worker-backup.XXXXXX")
cp -p "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$backup/"
cp -p "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" "$backup/"
rollback() {
 cp -p "$backup/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
 cp -p "$backup/userbot_test_client.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
 rm -f "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || :
 echo USERBOT_CODE_ONLY_ROLLBACK_REQUESTED
}
trap rollback ERR
cp -p "$w/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
cp -p "$w/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
cp -p "$w/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"
for f in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py; do cmp -s "$w/$f" "$r/$f" || exit 75; done
PYTHONPATH="$r/scripts" python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast, pathlib
for name in ('userbot_resident_ipc.py', 'userbot_test_client.py', 'userbot_room_public_smoke.py'):
 ast.parse((pathlib.Path('scripts') / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print('USERBOT_CODE_ONLY_PARSE_PASS')
PY
systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service
ready=no
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && "$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=yes; break; fi
 sleep 1
done
test "$ready" = yes || exit 76
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 77
test "$(stat -c %i "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = "$old_inode" || exit 78
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = "$old_mode" || exit 79
trap - ERR
echo USERBOT_PUBLIC_ROOM_E2E_CODE_ACTIVATED=PASS
echo USERBOT_EXISTING_SESSION_PRESERVED=PASS
echo USERBOT_HEALTH_AFTER_RESTART=PASS
